answer: Locks are recorded in pigment, expire in summit, and signal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 99 aliases thus needs 103 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1688 identities would post 1580 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
